programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto

Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: FishON | Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: My One Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

programme.title: Christmas in Carolina
programme.desc: Career-driven investment banker Elle has given up on love until she meets Wesley, who invites her to his hometown in South Carolina, where she rediscovers the spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Caught in the Crossfire
programme.desc: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: Escape Sangriento
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de sus cómplices, un narcotraficante planea un peligroso escape de prisión.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Los Humillados
programme.desc: Dos hermanos, uno compositor y el otro cantante, van a probar fama y fortuna a la capital.

programme.title: Family Feud Favorites
programme.desc: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites. This fast-paced clip show delivers the funniest, most viral and most unforgettable highlights from America's favorite game show. From hilariously wrong answers to Steve Harvey's one-of-a kind reactions, "Family Feud Favorites" captures the best moments that fans can't stop talking about.

programme.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
programme.desc: Four teams of exes must deal with 3 stunts and each other in order to win $50,000

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Jet Ski to Helicopter, Eat Beetles and Rope Crawl

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's an upside-down dual dunk and an endurance isolation challenge with bad smells, sounds, and more.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must find keys in a tank of snakes, play target shooting to see how many beetles they must eat, and bob in a tank for pig hearts.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Sky Surfing The first stunt required the twins to work as teams. The siblings would stand on a platform suspended 100-feet above the crashing sea below. As the platform teeter-tottered up and down, the twins had to gather as many flags as possible from the surrounding edges of the platform.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will climb through a 30ft plexiglass tunnel while a fire hose sprays them with a gross fluid. A truss structure will be wrapped on all four sides and bottom by cargo netting and hung beneath a helicopter. On "go" the contestant will begin to work their way around the outside of the cargo netting to release flags along the way.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This 30-minute clip show had highlights from animal stunts featured in the first three seasons of Fear Factor. Clips included worms, rats, snakes, bulls, bees, attack dogs, alligators, Madagascar hissing cockroaches, and scorpions.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: When the game starts, the cabinet will be slowly submerged. When it is completely underwater, the second contestant must dive in and unlock all three locks to release their partner. One person retrieves roaches from a big heart-shaped "candy box" using only his or her mouth and transfers it to their partner's mouth.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: On "go", a room will begin to be lowered into the water at a constant speed. The contestants must get out of their chair and go to the far end of the room to retrieve a ring of keys. Dressed in a dog bite protection suit, contestants must place 4 presents into corresponding stockings while being attacked by a trained attack dog.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's zip-lining from a lighthouse and a high-stakes balance beam, and a shocking bicycle.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's navigating a maze in a car with one person on a 30-foot pole and struggle through a swap obstacle course.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's tug-of-war on top of buildings, cages filled with roaches, and co-driving a car around fast-moving obstacles.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must walk around a 12 inch perimeter while an apparatus which is turning raised in the air, fastest time without falling wins. After that its the Eel tank and Heli Rodeo.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Family Special - Contestants will leap frog between rafts, traverse a tunnel filled with guts and complete an extreme obstacle course

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Players must dive under a submarine and collect glow sticks; munching crickets; dropping from a crane.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will dive to a submerged bus to rescue dummies, retrieve tokens from cow brains and walk over a rickety suspended beam course.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must jump between two moving flatbed trucks, lie in a coffin filled with worms, and be tumbled in a giant cylinder over water.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants are handcuffed inside a bag and dropped into water, dipped upside down into a tank of bugs, and time trialled on a transparent high ledge.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Truck Jump, Worm Coffin and Reverse Bungee.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Helicopter Jump Contestants would be riding in a helicopter as if flew 25 feet above a lake. As the helicopter flew over an island of boxes, they would have to jump out and try to land on the boxes. Contestants who hit any part of the boxes would advance to the next round. Anyone who missed the boxes entirely would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Helicopter Climb Each player would hang from the bottom rung of that ladder and as the helicopter spun above the cold Pacific Ocean, they would have to climb up and into the "bird". The four players with the best times would advance.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For this twins stunt, one contestant will be seated in a helicopter and the other will be on a quick-release. On "go" the helicopter will fly towards a drop zone where the seated contestant will release their twin to the water. Working as a team, couples will tear chunks of meat off of a cow jaw using only their mouths and run through a 30ft trench filled with cow parts.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will will have to put out a fire and rescue a dummy from its bed, lay in a pit while 3,000 scorpions are dropped on them. And climb a platform which flips end over end.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This episode featured six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner would receive $50,000 for their charity, and the others would receive 10,000 dollars for their charities.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must race a go-kart on a track over 100 feet in the air and must stop their front wheels between a yellow line and the end of the track. Round ball in stunt two as the players have to shoot basketballs from four spots. If they miss, they have to drink an 8-ounce glass of blended bugs
programme.sub-title: Go Cart Chicken/Fear Factor Basketball/Water Rotisserie

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Stunt one is for the dogs as contestants make their way through an urban assault training building and press buttons to raise 6 flags. Along the way, they would have to get past 4 trained attack dogs. Stunt two is a gas as they have to stay inside a room full of CS gas (tear gas). The three contestants to stay in the room the longest would advance to the final.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's an escape from a helicopter cargo net, a crawl through a horrifying tunnel maze, and a heist from a submerged armoured car.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This was part one of a two-part Championship edition. In Part 1 of the Fear Factor Tournament of Champions, the 13 players who had won before on Fear Factor during the second season competed again to compete for the Fear Factor Championship and 100,000 dollars prize. There are five stunts. The men and women will compete separately until the last stunt.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will collect candy canes while sliding along a platform, gift gross food items with no take-backs, and swim under a flaming plexiglass grid.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be dragged by dune buggies, bury their teammates head in worms, and aim for a landing from a helicopter drop

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants brave a dog attack, submerge themselves in a tank full of snakes and traverse a beam 100 feet in the air.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestant's heads are placed in separate medieval-looking helmets (one filled with snakes the other with rats). In this stunt, one of the contestants will be wearing weighted boots. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. programme.sub-title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

programme.title: House of 1000 Corpses
programme.desc: An empty fuel tank and a flat tire lead two couples down a terror-riddled road to the House of 1000 Corpses. House of 1000 Corpses is at its core a story of family - a cast of twisted individuals who, with each slash of a throat or stab through the chest, add bodies to their sick human menagerie.

programme.title: The Devil's Rejects
programme.desc: After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. Heading to a remote desert motel, the killers reunite with Baby's father, Capt. Spaulding (Sid Haig), who is equally demented and intent on maintaining their murder spree. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

programme.title: 3 From Hell
programme.desc: Crazed killers Baby Firefly, Captain Spaulding and Otis Driftwood unleash bloody mayhem after escaping from prison.

programme.title: The Lords of Salem
programme.desc: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room.

programme.title: A Simple Favor
programme.desc: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. When Emily mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into her friend's past, finding a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: American Ultra
programme.desc: Small-town stoner Mike Howell (Jesse Eisenberg) spends most of his time getting high and writing a graphic novel. What Mike doesn't know is that he was trained by the CIA to be a lethal killing machine. When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent is called upon to guard the life of his mortal enemy, one of the world's most notorious hit men. The relentless bodyguard and manipulative assassin have been on the opposite end of the bullet for years and are thrown together for a wildly outrageous 24 hours. During their journey from England to The Hague, they encounter high-speed car chases, outlandish boat escapades and a merciless Eastern European dictator who is out for blood.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce and hitman Darius Kincaid are back for another life-threatening mission; still unlicensed and under scrutiny, Bryce is forced into action by Darius's even more volatile wife; soon, all three are in over their heads when a madman's sinister plot threatens to leave Europe in chaos.

programme.title: Long Shot
programme.desc: Fred Flarsky is a gifted and free-spirited journalist who has a knack for getting into trouble. Charlotte Field is one of the most influential women in the world -- a smart, sophisticated and accomplished politician. When Fred unexpectedly runs into Charlotte, he soon realizes that she was his former babysitter and childhood crush. When Charlotte decides to make a run for the presidency, she impulsively hires Fred as her speechwriter -- much to the dismay of her trusted advisers.

programme.desc: In custody in New York, Detective James Knight finds himself in the middle of a jailbreak led by The Christmas Bomber, a brutal fanatic whose Santa Claus disciples are terrorizing the city.

programme.desc: Detective James Knight's last-minute assignment to the Independence Day shift turns into a race against time to stop an unbalanced EMT worker who's posing as a cop.

Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him.

programme.title: The Invisible Man Returns
programme.desc: Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

programme.title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
programme.desc: A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Invisible Ray
programme.desc: A scientist (Bela Lugosi) seeks an antidote for a radium-poisoned colleague (Boris Karloff) with the touch of death.

programme.title: The Invisible Woman

programme.title: Island of Lost Souls
programme.desc: In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Simsbury, CT to the old Pettibone Tavern to solve the legendary story of the ghost of Abigail. Pettibone's daughter Abigail, was married to a sailor.
programme.sub-title: So I Married an Axe Murderer

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to North Kingstown, Rhode Island to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a local restaurant. Linda, the skeptical owner of the Hoofinfeathers Carriage Inn, is hoping to uncover the truth behind the bizarre stories plaguing her establishment. The reports of disembodied voices and phantom-like apparitions have frightened some of her guests and terrorized her staff.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Mudd was convicted for his role in the plot even though the evidence was highly circumstantial. Today, apparitions and other strange activity have been witnessed inside, and directly outside, the house. Through their investigation, the team uncovers evidence that Mudd may be trying to prove his innocence from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings (Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian) must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters. Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.
